verdict.rationale: Persona has a broad API surface: pre-creating inquiries, polling inquiry statuses and verification details, running reports, webhooks, simulate actions for testing, and a backend-only Transactions API for fully custom flows. However, nothing shows that dashboard-side configuration (inquiry templates, workflows, Cases) can be managed through the API, and IP allowlisting is set by visiting the API Key Configuration page, which points to UI-only administration. Missing for 10: evidence of API coverage for template, workflow, and case configuration; an explicit API/UI parity statement; API management of security settings; independent corroboration.
